description: Allows traffic into or out of a VPC.

fields.label: Direction
fields.help: Direction of traffic to which this firewall applies; default is INGRESS.

fields.label: Source Ranges
fields.help: If source ranges are specified, the firewall will apply only to traffic that has source IP address in these ranges.

fields.label: Target Tags
fields.help: A list of instance tags indicating sets of instances located in the network that may make network connections as specified in allowed[].

fields.label: Allowed traffic
Protocol
fields.help: The IP protocol to which this rule applies.

fields.label: Ports
fields.help: Leave empty for all ports. Not valid when protocol is icmp.
The list of ALLOW rules specified by this firewall.
